title: The Weather Today and Yesterday
text:
Today the weather is sunny. The sun is hot and the sky is blue. My friends and I go to the park. We play football.

Yesterday it was cold and rainy. I stayed at home. I read a book and drank hot tea.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What did the writer do yesterday?
How does the writer probably feel today?
Why did the writer probably drink hot tea yesterday?

vocabulary.definition: with bright sunshine in the sky
with a lot of rain falling

paragraph_translations: Hoy el clima está soleado. El sol está caliente y el cielo está azul. Mis amigos y yo vamos al parque. Jugamos al fútbol.
Ayer hizo frío y llovía. Me quedé en casa. Leí un libro y bebí té caliente.
